verdict.rationale: Smooth ships an official, first-party CLI aimed at AI agents. It has a dedicated docs section covering the overview, Claude Code, OpenClaw and other-agent integrations, plus feature pages for localhost, data extraction, authentication, files and live view. A probe confirms the CLI documentation exists, and the GitHub repo names the Smooth CLI as an agent browser. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and an explicit command reference or install instructions in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Smooth CLI is a browser for AI agents, enabling tools like Claude Code to navigate the web quickly, cheaply, and reliably.
Smooth CLI works with any agent that can run CLI commands.
Ask Claude to do something on the web. It will use Smooth automatically.
